shared_elements: low relief carving on a stone surface
repeated small motifs arranged in a row along a band
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in low relief with profile quadrupeds and human(oid) figures organised against horizontal dividing bands, which is the most concrete correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a rough, weathered pillar with schematic, isolated animals stacked vertically on an irregular block, while B is a smoothly dressed ashlar wall carrying a polished, naturalistic, evenly spaced procession framed by ornamental rosette borders.
